 Hon'Ble Ms. Justice Neena Bansal Krishna
 Order

Petition under Section 528 of the Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 has been filed on behalf of the Petitioners for quashing of FIR No.0289/2018 under Sections 498A/406 IPC registered at PS:
Bawana, Delhi, in terms of Joint Settlements dated 07.01.2019 and 31.01.2019.
2. It is submitted that after these settlements, Respondent No.2 is not forthcoming.

3. On filing PF, Notice be issued to Respondent No.2 through IO/SHO concerned, returnable on 19.09.2025.
4.

List on 19.09.2025.
NEENA BANSAL KRISHNA, J.
AUGUST 05, 2025/R
